text.p: Checkers Drive-In Restaurants Inc said on Friday it has received $20.0 million in consideration for issuing 8,771,929 shares of common stock and 87,719 shares of Series A preferred stock.

CKE Restaurants Inc purchased 6,162,299 of Checkers common stock and 61,636 shares of Checkers Series A preferred stock and other qualified investors purchased the remaining shares in the private placement, Checkers said.

The Series A preferred stock will be converted into common stock upon shareholder approval at the annual shareholders' meeting and carries a dividend rate of 14.5 percent in the event shareholders fail to approve the conversion, Checkers said.
Checkers plans to use the proceeds from the private placement to pay credit facility debt, a credit line and debts to vendor, it said.
The private placement will cut interest expense by $1.3 million annually, Checkers said.
The number of shares outstanding and the conversion ratio for the preferred shares were not immediately available.
